[Thinking]
**Identifying Youngest Member**

I'm currently processing information to pinpoint the youngest member of the American boy band "Why Don't We." My focus is on comparing their birthdates to determine who holds that distinction.

**Determining Youngest Member**

I've analyzed the birthdates of each "Why Don't We" member and have definitively identified Zach Herron, born May 27, 2001, as the youngest.
[/Thinking]

アメリカのボーイズバンド「ホワイ・ドント・ウィー（Why Don't We）」の中で一番若いメンバーは、**ザック・ヘロン（Zach Herron）**です。彼は2001年5月27日生まれです。
